pg058_sec001_n0005: Neema's face was swollen, so her mother took her to hospital.
pg058_sec001_n0006: While playing, Neema was stung by a bee which was on a flower of the tree, and she felt severe pain.
pg058_sec001_n0007: The doctor gave Neema medicine and told her that bees are dangerous insects that sting and leave poison in the body, causing various effects.
pg058_sec001_n0009: The doctor also told Neema that other dangerous insects are ants, mosquitoes and wasps.
